34th Avenue Citi Bike Weekly Ride

Jackson Heights, NY · Queens · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

34th Avenue Citi Bike Weekly Ride is a social group ride in Jackson Heights, NY. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am from Citi Bike station, 34th Avenue between 93rd & 94th Streets. Pace: beginner pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the 34th Avenue Citi Bike Weekly Ride group ride

A beginner group ride led by the 34th Avenue Open Streets Coalition. You can ride a Citi Bike at no charge. No sign-up; just show up. You need to already know how to ride. The schedule on Citi Bike's page was last posted for the 2025 season, so check the coalition's Instagram before you go.
